title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
description: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.
amenities: Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world

faqs.q: What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
faqs.a: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.

faqs.q: What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
faqs.a: The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.

faqs.q: When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
faqs.a: The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.

faqs.q: Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
faqs.a: The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.

faqs.q: Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
faqs.a: Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.

faqs.q: What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
faqs.a: The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

faqs.q: What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
faqs.a: Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.

faqs.q: Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
faqs.a: The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.

faqs.q: How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
faqs.a: It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.

faqs.q: How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
faqs.a: Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

title: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin
description: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, by DarGlobal. Residences range from one- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom beach villas, spanning 61 to 265 sqm, with Aston Martin-designed interiors and direct access to the beach on the water's edge.
investment_highlights: Why Invest Ras Al Khaimah, the fourth-largest emirate in the United Arab Emirates, is home to the newly opened RAK Market, which launched just two years ago. Some of the most desirable areas include Al Marjan Island, Al Hamra Village, and Mina Al Arab. Al Marjan Island's development strategy focuses on attracting a broad spectrum of international investors by offering luxurious amenities, serene ocean views, and a resort-style community. The emphasis on beachfront luxury, combined with the promise of high returns, positions Al Marjan Island as a prime destination for investment in the UAE's real estate market. The government has announced the opening of a WYNN Casino on Al Marjan Island itself in 2.5 years. This announcement has doubled market price over the past two years. 10-year Golden Visa: Available with an investment of 2 million AED Attractive Taxation: Enjoy 0% income Tax and 0% Property Tax Direct view of WYNN Resort: Just 5 minutes away from the first Wynn Resort in the Middle East Direct Beachfront Access: Enjoy stunning Beachfront Residences Convenient Location: Only 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport 100% Business Ownership: Full ownership of business High-Yield Opportunities: Potential to generate yields beyond 9% due to saturation in Dubai beachfront locations Emerging Market : RAK is experiencing significant growth with an average apartment capital value increase of 35% in the last year High Hotel Occupancy Rates: Projected peak in occupancy rate for the hospitality sector by 2027, nearing full capacity, indicated high demand for residential products Tourist Influx: Projected to attract 3-3.5 million tourists by 2030, driving rental yields and capital values Strong Regulatory Framework: Ensures buyer protection and project completion through RER

faqs.q: What is The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin?
faqs.a: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, developed by DarGlobal. Aston Martin's design team applied the brand's precision and craftsmanship to each unit, producing a collection of one- to three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beach villas directly on the water's edge.

faqs.q: What unit types and sizes are available at The Astera?
faqs.a: The Astera offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beachfront villas ranging from 61 to 265 sqm. All units feature Aston Martin-designed interiors and sit on Al Marjan Island with direct beach access.

faqs.q: What did Aston Martin design at The Astera?
faqs.a: Aston Martin's design team was responsible for the interiors of every residence, applying the brand's approach to precision, material quality, and artisanal craftsmanship to kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The collaboration integrates cutting-edge design with the timeless finishes associated with the Aston Martin brand.

faqs.q: When will The Astera be completed?
faqs.a: The Astera is under development with handover scheduled for December 2028. DarGlobal is the master developer responsible for delivery on Al Marjan Island. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

faqs.q: Where exactly is The Astera located?
faqs.a: The Astera is on Al Marjan Island, a man-made island off the Ras Al Khaimah coastline, 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. It sits approximately 5 minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East.

faqs.q: What amenities does The Astera offer?
faqs.a: Amenities include direct beach access, an infinity pool, spa, sauna, pool bar, fitness centre, indoor cinema, yoga lawn, multipurpose hall, children's play area, and premium 24/7 security. Beach villas offer private access to the shoreline directly from the residence.

faqs.q: Is The Astera a good investment in Ras Al Khaimah?
faqs.a: Al Marjan Island is an emerging market where average apartment capital values rose approximately 35% in a single year. Branded residences historically command price premiums of 30 to 200% over comparable unbranded stock, and the Wynn Resort announcement has been directly linked to market price doubling over two years. Buyers should seek independent investment advice.

faqs.q: What is the UAE Golden Visa benefit for buyers at The Astera?
faqs.a: Buyers investing 2 million AED or more in UAE real estate may apply for a 10-year Golden Visa. The UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax, providing a tax-efficient holding environment for both resident and international buyers.

faqs.q: How does the Wynn Resort affect Al Marjan Island property values?
faqs.a: The announcement of the Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East, has been directly linked to a doubling of market prices over the past two years. The resort will be approximately 5 minutes from The Astera and is expected to drive further tourism and rental demand for beachfront properties on the island.

faqs.q: How do I register interest or buy at The Astera?
faqs.a: Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

faqs.a: Da Vinci Tower is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Pagani Automobili and is the world's first Pagani-branded residential development.

faqs.q: Where is Da Vinci Tower located?
faqs.a: Da Vinci Tower is located in Downtown Dubai, directly on the Dubai Canal, with views of the Burj Khalifa and moments from Marasi Business Bay.

faqs.q: What types of residences are available at Da Vinci Tower?
faqs.a: The tower offers 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences ranging from 77 to 398 sq m, each with private outdoor areas and panoramic views of the canal and Downtown Dubai.

faqs.q: Is Da Vinci Tower really the first Pagani residential project?
faqs.a: Yes. Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residential development with interiors by Pagani, applying the brand's design philosophy to luxury living.

faqs.q: What do the Pagani-designed interiors include?
faqs.a: Interiors crafted by Pagani feature premium leather, Italian marble, kinetic chandeliers, carbon fibre accents and lush wood panelling.

faqs.q: What amenities does Da Vinci Tower offer?
faqs.a: Amenities include a rooftop pool overlooking Downtown Dubai, a state-of-the-art gym, sauna and steam rooms, 24/7 concierge, and private access to the residences through discreet elevators.

faqs.q: How tall is Da Vinci Tower?
faqs.a: The tower rises 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor.

faqs.q: How far is Da Vinci Tower from key Dubai landmarks?
faqs.a: The Dubai Mall and Fountains are about 9 minutes away, and Dubai Marina is around 20 minutes away.

faqs.q: Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing here?
faqs.a: Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE 10-year Golden Visa, and Dubai applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax.

faqs.q: What makes Da Vinci Tower unique?
faqs.a: Da Vinci Tower is the world’s first residential development by DarGlobal with interiors designed by Pagani Automobili, bringing the design philosophy of the iconic Italian hypercar manufacturer into luxury living.

details: The Pagani Penthouse Dubai, UAE Pagani’s essence has taken shape, for the first time in the world, in a residential building in the heart of Dubai. The culmination of the first ever living experience, by the super automaker is the Penthouse. Overview Pagani’s essence has taken shape, for the first time in the world, in a residential building in the heart of Dubai. The culmination of the first ever living experience, by the super automaker is the Penthouse. Spanning 14,768 sqft, where every square foot is worthy of a masterpiece. Living in the Sphere The expansive residence extending the entire top floor is accented with the most unique feature of the penthouse, the sphere. A sphere completely constructed with geometric glass panes to give you 360 degree views, from the sweeping Dubai Canal to Downtown Dubai. Elevating the Standards of Living Residents and guests arrive at the Pagani Penthouse in its very own personal elevator. After being welcomed inside, advanced domotics are available to respond to their every touch. The Living Spaces A timeless interpretation of automotive art. The living spaces are designed with heritage leather, and luxurious fabrics that are reminiscent to the interiors of a Pagani car. The Personal Spaces Traces of the Italian supercar are steeped in hushed tones of the bedrooms, and en-suite bathrooms. The rooms are reminiscent of the ultra-modern interiors of the Pagani, serene and victorious. Location The Pagani Penthouse is perched on The DaVinci Tower, which sits at the heart of Dubai’s cultural district, surrounded by prominent landmarks, such as the Dubai Opera, exhibition centres, design houses, art galleries, and affluent neighbourhoods. This gives you the perfect opportunity to explore various shopping, dining, and cultural experiences by the Dubai Canal, Business Bay and Burj Khalifa. faqs.q: What is Tierra Viva?
faqs.a: Tierra Viva is a limited collection of ultra-luxury gated villas in Benahavís, Spain, developed by DarGlobal with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. Villas are staggered across the hillside at different levels in the Los Jaralillos district to ensure every home captures unobstructed panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea.

faqs.q: What is Automobili Lamborghini's involvement in Tierra Viva?
faqs.a: Automobili Lamborghini provided the design inspiration for Tierra Viva, with the project integrating the brand's approach to cutting-edge design, technology, and artisanal craftsmanship into villa architecture and interiors. The collaboration between DarGlobal and Lamborghini positions Tierra Viva as a convergence of performance culture and ultra-luxury residential living.

faqs.q: What villa sizes are available at Tierra Viva?
faqs.a: Tierra Viva offers a limited collection of villas ranging from 700 to 1,450 sqm. The collection is available in different villa configurations, including select units with an in-villa car lift. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability and full specification details.

faqs.q: When will Tierra Viva be completed?
faqs.a: Tierra Viva is under development with completion scheduled for June 2028. Construction is actively underway, with progress updates available on the DarGlobal website. Contact the sales team for current payment plan terms and unit availability.

faqs.q: Where exactly is Tierra Viva located?
faqs.a: Tierra Viva is in the hills of Los Jaralillos, Benahavís, 15 minutes from Marbella and within easy reach of Puerto Banús and Sotogrande. The location gives direct access to 12 nearby golf clubs, Andalusian villages, and the shores of the Mediterranean, while remaining in one of the most prestigious residential areas on the Costa Del Sol.

faqs.q: What amenities does Tierra Viva offer?
faqs.a: Tierra Viva is a gated community with 24/7 premium security, an exclusive residents' clubhouse, sauna, steam room, and private pool areas. Select Painite villas include an in-villa car lift. The community is designed around the concept of seclusion and belonging rather than shared hotel-style facilities.

faqs.q: Can I obtain a Spain Golden Visa by purchasing at Tierra Viva?
faqs.a: Spain's Golden Visa programme is available to non-EU buyers making qualifying real estate investments. Given villa sizes and values at Tierra Viva, buyers should confirm current programme thresholds and eligibility with a qualified legal adviser, as Spain's Golden Visa rules have been subject to legislative review. DarGlobal can assist with introductions to legal professionals.

faqs.q: Why invest in Costa Del Sol real estate?
faqs.a: Spain is consistently ranked as offering among the highest real estate ROI in Europe, with low Eurozone interest rates between 3 and 5%, open regulations for foreign investors, and a robust tourism sector that supports rental returns. Benahavís specifically is one of the wealthiest municipalities in Spain and benefits from year-round Mediterranean climate and high-speed train connections to the wider coast.

faqs.q: What makes a Lamborghini-branded villa different from other luxury villas in Spain?
faqs.a: Branded residences at this tier consistently command significant price premiums over comparable unbranded stock. Tierra Viva combines the scarcity of a limited villa collection in Benahavís, one of Europe's most sought-after addresses, with a globally recognised automotive design brand. That pairing targets a very specific international buyer pool, which supports both value retention and resale appetite.

faqs.q: How do I register interest or buy a villa at Tierra Viva?
faqs.a: Buyers can register interest, browse the collection, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current villa availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

title: Painite Villas Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
description: The Painite Villas are luxurious six-bedroom villas located in the south of Spain, featuring exclusive Sky Car Lift technology by Automobili Lamborghini and offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea.
details: Painite Villas Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini Benahavís, Spain The Painite Villas are luxurious six-bedroom villas located in the south of Spain, featuring exclusive Sky Car Lift technology by Automobili Lamborghini and offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea. Side by side The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space. Private sky car lift The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea. The Villa The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury. The View THE VIEWS The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity. The Amenities Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty. Location The Painite Villas are located in Tierra Viva in Marbella, one of the most affluent locations around the world. Home to the most stylish clubs, restaurants and hotels, as well as, shopping areas, exclusive marinas and breathtaking beaches. The villas are precisely nestled in the hills, only minutes away from the shores and in close proximity to 9 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banus. Floor Plans For floor

Elie Saab provided the interior design for each residence and the building's common areas, bringing the Lebanese fashion house's signature aesthetic of cream, marble, bronze, and premium stone to one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments.

faqs.q: What did Elie Saab design at Les Vagues?
faqs.a: Elie Saab was responsible for the full interior design of each residence, as well as the building's lounges and lobby areas, personally selecting all furniture for the common spaces. faqs.q: What unit types and sizes are available at Les Vagues?
faqs.a: Les Vagues offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences ranging from 86 to 389 sqm on Qetaifan Island North. faqs.q: When will Les Vagues by Elie Saab be completed?

faqs.q: Where is Les Vagues located?
faqs.a: Les Vagues is on Qetaifan Island North, a 1.3 million sqm man-made island off the coast of Doha, Qatar. faqs.q: What amenities does Les Vagues offer within the building?

faqs.q: What are Trump Cliff Villas at AIDA?
faqs.a: Trump Cliff Villas are a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom sea-view villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly beside the Trump International Hotel at 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with a private pool overlooking the sea. Villas are designed and furnished to the highest standard, with every detail specified down to specification.

faqs.q: What are the villa sizes and unit types available?
faqs.a: Trump Cliff Villas offer three-bedroom furnished residences from 128 to 166 sqm. Each villa includes a private pool with sea views. Owners receive a Trump International Golf Club Social Membership as part of the purchase and have the option to reside in or lease the villa.

faqs.q: What does the Trump Cliff Villas offer that other AIDA products do not?
faqs.a: Trump Cliff Villas offer full villa ownership with a private pool, the closest positioning to the Trump International Hotel, and the most elevated sea views on the AIDA estate. Unlike Trump Golf Villas, which face the golf course, These villas are positioned on the cliff edge with direct sea orientation. Both villa products sit within the same AIDA estate and share access to the same championship golf course and community facilities.

faqs.q: What amenities are available to Trump Cliff Villa owners?
faqs.a: Within the AIDA estate, villa owners have access to the Trump International Golf Club Oman (18-hole championship course), Trump Members Only Club, The SHFT Night Club, 5-star dining and culinary facilities, AIDA Beach, Trump Hotels Hanging Suites, a Trump International Hotel lobby, community and retail centres, plazas, cafes and restaurants, wellness centres, fitness centre, promenades, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, viewing decks, and outdoor landscapes across the cliffside estate.

faqs.q: When will Trump Cliff Villas be completed?
faqs.a: Completion is scheduled for December 2028. Construction is underway and live progress feeds are available on the DarGlobal project page. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to book a unit, choose your residence via the online navigator, or download the project brochure.

faqs.q: Can I lease my Trump Cliff Villa when I am not using it?
faqs.a: Yes. The entry data states that owners have the choice to reside in or lease their villa. The Trump management association with the property supports the leasing proposition. Contact DarGlobal for further details on the leasing model and revenue arrangements.

faqs.q: Can foreign nationals buy Trump Cliff Villas in Oman?
faqs.a: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. ITC project buyers are eligible for a lifetime residency visa in Oman. An exclusive mortgage program is available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers. Buyers should confirm specific eligibility conditions with DarGlobal or their legal advisor.

faqs.q: What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman real estate?
faqs.a: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

faqs.q: Why invest in Muscat property now?
faqs.a: Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in both Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries in the world. Tourism earnings are projected to exceed $22.5 billion per year by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time between the two countries by 16 hours, and an upcoming UAE-Muscat railway project will further strengthen connectivity and investment activity.

faqs.q: How do Trump Cliff Villas relate to the wider AIDA development?
faqs.a: Trump Cliff Villas are one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. faqs.a: AIDA is a fully master-planned destination in Muscat, Oman, designed as a city within a city. Developed by DarGlobal, it combines luxury residences, branded hotels, golf courses, nature, and lifestyle amenities in one integrated community.

faqs.q: Where is AIDA located in Oman?
faqs.a: AIDA is in Muscat, Oman, about 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, elevated 130 meters above sea level along the coastline, offering scenic views.

faqs.q: Can international buyers own property at AIDA?
faqs.a: Yes. AIDA offers 100% foreign ownership within designated investment zones, ideal for investors and second-home buyers.

faqs.q: How can I register my interest or book a viewing at AIDA?
faqs.a: You can register your interest through our website or by visiting one of our offices . If you are outside Oman, the sales team will contact you and arrange the most suitable way to connect. If you are in Oman or planning a visit, you can visit the office and enjoy a private, one on one site tour, including a visit to the development, the views, and the latest construction updates.

faqs.q: What types of properties are available at AIDA?
faqs.a: AIDA offers apartments, luxury villas, hotel residences, and branded or non-branded residences. Explore your options for investment or lifestyle living.

faqs.q: Are there branded residences at AIDA?
faqs.a: Yes. AIDA features branded residences in collaboration with internationally recognized brands, including Trump and Marriott.

faqs.q: Does property ownership include golf access?
faqs.a: Golf access is available through membership at Trump International Golf Club Oman, subject to application and approval.

faqs.q: Who is developing AIDA in Oman?
faqs.a: AIDA is a master plan developed by DarGlobal in partnership with OMRAN, collaborating with global brands such as the Trump Organization and Marriott .

faqs.q: What makes AIDA a city within a city?
faqs.a: AIDA offers residential living, hospitality, leisure, wellness, retail, and outdoor experiences all in one destination, allowing residents to live, relax, and socialize without leaving the community.

faqs.q: Is AIDA a gated community in Muscat, Oman?
faqs.a: Yes. AIDA is a private, gated community in Muscat offering controlled access, security, and a secure residential environment designed for privacy and peace of mind.

faqs.q: Who is AIDA designed for?
faqs.a: AIDA is designed for end users, second-home owners, and international investors seeking a luxury resort lifestyle, long-term value, and globally benchmarked living standards in Oman.

faqs.q: How accessible is AIDA from the region?
faqs.a: AIDA is accessible with a 60-minute flight from Dubai and has strong connections to regional and international destinations.

faqs.q: What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.a: Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.

faqs.q: Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.a: The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.

faqs.q: What unit types and sizes are available?
faqs.a: The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.

faqs.q: What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
faqs.a: Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.

faqs.q: What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
faqs.a: The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.

faqs.q: When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
faqs.a: Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.

faqs.q: Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
faqs.a: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.

faqs.q: What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
faqs.a: Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.

faqs.q: Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
faqs.a: Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.

faqs.q: How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
faqs.a: Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

title: 7&8 Albert Hall Mansions
description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

faqs.a: Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad is a collection of luxury branded villas in northern Riyadh, developed by DarGlobal. Mouawad, the internationally renowned jewellery house, designed the interiors of each five-bedroom villa, bringing its signature approach to refined finishes, artisanal craftsmanship, and timeless elegance to a residential setting.

faqs.q: What did Mouawad design at Neptune?
faqs.a: Mouawad provided the full interior design across each Neptune villa, applying the brand's heritage in precision and luxury material quality to every room from the entry foyer and living spaces through to the master suite, bathrooms, and kitchen. The collaboration translates Mouawad's jewellery-house sensibility into an architectural and residential context.

faqs.q: What villa sizes are available at Neptune?
faqs.a: Neptune offers five-bedroom villas with built-up areas ranging from 300 to 420 sqm. Each villa includes a master bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite, secondary bedrooms, a family kitchen, guest living area, and terrace with views of the surrounding landscape.

faqs.q: When will Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad be completed?
faqs.a: The project is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. DarGlobal is the master developer. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms, or explore available villas via the online residence navigator.

faqs.q: Where is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad located?
faqs.a: Neptune is in the northern district of Riyadh, positioned in close proximity to the Expo 2030 Riyadh site, placing residents at the centre of one of Saudi Arabia's most significant urban development corridors under Vision 2030.

faqs.q: What community amenities surround Neptune?
faqs.a: The Neptune community is supported by schools, a community centre, sports hub, restaurants and cafes, public parks, entertainment centres, early childhood centres, retail and grocery, playgrounds, mosques, and healthcare clinics within the wider neighbourhood.

faqs.q: Is Riyadh real estate open to foreign investors?
faqs.a: Yes. Full freehold ownership is now available to foreign investors in Saudi Arabia. Property investment of 4 million SAR or more qualifies buyers for residency eligibility. The Saudi Riyal is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability, and Saudi Arabia applies 0% capital gains tax, 0% wealth tax, and 0% inheritance tax.

faqs.q: Why invest in Riyadh property under Saudi Vision 2030?
faqs.a: Riyadh is set to host the FIFA World Cup 2034, Expo 2030, Formula 1, and the Asian Games, driving unprecedented infrastructure investment. King Salman International Airport is scaling to 185 million passengers, and Riyadh Air is expanding global connectivity. Saudi Arabia is considered one of the safest countries globally and the safest in the G20.

faqs.q: What makes Neptune a limited-edition collection?
faqs.a: Neptune is positioned as a limited edition collection, meaning a restricted number of villas are available, each featuring bespoke Mouawad interiors and individual design attention that cannot be replicated at scale. The scarcity of a Mouawad-branded residential product in Riyadh places it in a distinct tier above standard luxury villa developments in the city.

faqs.a: Buyers can register interest, explore available villas via the online residence navigator, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

description: Investor Relations ABOUT US DarGlobal Today DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer specializing in exclusive luxury developments across the world’s most coveted cosmopolitan cities. Catering to global citizens seeking prime investments, second homes, and luxury living, DarGlobal transforms real estate into economic catalysts, unlocking opportunities for both investors and the countries it enters. DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. These collaborations offer unique investment opportunities in global cities, providing both wealth growth and protection. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal goes beyond property development; it drives economic transformation by attracting international clients and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI). With a presence in 13 international cities across 8 countries, DarGlobal’s portfolio spans the United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, the United States, and Qatar. The company is also expanding into world-class hospitality, developing luxury hotels in Dubai, Muscat, Riyadh and Jeddah. To support its international clientele, DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha. By injecting capital, confidence, and industry expertise, DarGlobal enhances local infrastructure while elevating the global appeal of each destination. With a presence in 14 international cities across 9 countries, DarGlobal’s portfolio spans the United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, and Qatar. The company is also expanding into world-class hospitality, developing luxury hotels in Dubai, the Maldives, and Oman. To support its international clientele, DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha. DarGlobal is a strategic investment partner, catering to investors looking to grow, preserve, or diversify their wealth. Every opportunity is backed by market insight, strategic planning, and long-term value.
